headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 11, 2026**
article:
The Philadelphia Phillies suffered a blowout loss to the Detroit Tigers, while the New York Yankees secured a victory over the Washington Nationals. The Kansas City Royals snapped their winning streak with a loss to the Baltimore Orioles, and the Chicago Cubs were shut out by the Cincinnati Reds.

Top news stories from around the league include the Phillies' 10-2 loss to the Tigers, with Derek Hill leading the Tigers' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance. The Yankees took down the Nationals 5-3, with James Wood leading the Nationals' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance. The Royals fell to the Orioles 5-3, snapping their winning streak, while the Cubs were shut out by the Reds 4-0.

Several players have been placed on the injured list, including Athletics first baseman Nick Kurtz, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right thumb capsule sprain. The injury is retroactive to July 10, 2026. Other players who have been placed on the injured list include Konnor Griffin of the Pittsburgh Pirates, Kyle Harrison of the Milwaukee Brewers, Victor Bericoto of the San Francisco Giants, Mick Abel of the Minnesota Twins, Zack Gelof of the Athletics, Mark Vientos of the New York Mets, and Jake Irvin of the Washington Nationals.

There have been several trades and roster moves around the league, including the Chicago White Sox acquiring LHP Jaden Woods from the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for LHP Brandon Eisert and 1B Jacob Gonzalez. The Minnesota Twins acquired RHP Tommy Nance from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for C Ryan Sprock and future considerations. The New York Mets acquired RHP Matt Seelinger from the Detroit Tigers in exchange for cash.

top_news.title: **Phillies Fall to Tigers in Blowout**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies suffered a 10-2 loss to the Detroit Tigers, with the Tigers dominating the game from start to finish. Derek Hill led the Tigers' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Nationals 5-3**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-3 victory over the Washington Nationals in their latest matchup. James Wood led the Nationals' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall to Orioles in 5-3 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals dropped a 5-3 decision to the Baltimore Orioles, snapping their winning streak. Samuel Basallo led the Royals' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cubs Fall to Reds in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs were defeated 4-0 by the Cincinnati Reds, with Hunter Greene pitching a strong 7.0 innings, striking out 12 and allowing no earned runs. JJ Bleday led the Cubs' offense with a home run and 2 RBI.

top_news.title: **Athletics Place Nick Kurtz on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Athletics first baseman Nick Kurtz has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right thumb capsule sprain. The injury is retroactive to July 10, 2026.

top_news.title: **White Sox Acquire LHP Jaden Woods in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, trading LHP Brandon Eisert and 1B Jacob Gonzalez to the Pittsburgh Pirates for LHP Jaden Woods and future considerations. The trade was completed on July 11, 2026.
